description: This file defines the ResourceProfile class and related classes and objects for managing resource profiles in Apache Spark, including resource requests for executors and tasks, default profiles, and resource calculations.

classes.name: ResourceProfile
classes.description: Represents a resource profile for an RDD, including executor and task resource requests, with methods for validation, resource calculation, and comparison.

classes.name: TaskResourceProfile
classes.description: A specialized ResourceProfile containing only task resources, used for stage-level scheduling when dynamic allocation is disabled.

classes.name: ResourceProfile.ExecutorResourcesOrDefaults
classes.description: Data class holding executor resource configuration and defaults.

classes.name: ResourceProfile.DefaultProfileExecutorResources
classes.description: Data class for default executor resource configuration.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.validate
methods.description: Validates the resource profile, ensuring task resource amounts are within acceptable ranges.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getExecutorCores
methods.description: Retrieves the number of cores requested for executors.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getTaskCpus
methods.description: Retrieves the number of CPUs requested for tasks.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getPySparkMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the PySpark memory request.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getOverheadMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the memory overhead request.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getExecutorOffHeap
methods.description: Retrieves the off-heap memory request.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getExecutorMemory
methods.description: Retrieves the executor memory request.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getCustomTaskResources
methods.description: Returns custom task resources excluding CPU.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getCustomExecutorResources
methods.description: Returns custom executor resources excluding supported built-in resources.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getSchedulerTaskResourceAmount
methods.description: Calculates the number of tasks that can share a resource address based on fractional amounts.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getNumSlotsPerAddress
methods.description: Calculates the number of slots per resource address.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.maxTasksPerExecutor
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of tasks per executor based on resource constraints.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.limitingResource
methods.description: Determines the limiting resource for task scheduling.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.calculateTasksAndLimitingResource
methods.description: Calculates the number of tasks per executor and the limiting resource based on resource requests.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.setResourceProfileId
methods.description: Sets the resource profile ID (used by history server).

methods.name: ResourceProfile.setToDefaultProfile
methods.description: Resets the profile to default for testing.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class, ID, and resource requests.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.resourcesEqual
methods.description: Checks if resource requests are equal, ignoring IDs.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on resource requests.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.toString
methods.description: String representation of the resource profile.

methods.name: TaskResourceProfile
methods.description: A resource profile with only task resources, used for stage scheduling.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getOrCreateDefaultProfile
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the default resource profile based on application configs.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getDefaultProfileExecutorResources
methods.description: Retrieves default executor resource configuration.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getDefaultTaskResources
methods.description: Retrieves default task resource requests from configuration.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getDefaultExecutorResources
methods.description: Retrieves default executor resource requests from configuration.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.calculateOverHeadMemory
methods.description: Calculates overhead memory based on configuration and executor memory.

methods.name: ResourceProfile.getResourcesForClusterManager
methods.description: Provides resource requests for cluster manager container requests.
